---
title: "cleanup-pr-previews.yml"
---

The housekeeping half of the PR-preview family. On a schedule, it deletes
`gh-pages` preview directories for pull requests that are no longer open.

## Inputs

| Input              | Type    | Default        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------ | ------- | -------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `preview-dir`      | string  | `'pr-preview'` | Directory on `gh-pages` that holds the per-PR preview subdirectories.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `compact-history`  | boolean | `false`        | Orphan-squash the `gh-pages` branch to a single commit after pruning, discarding accumulated preview/publish history to reclaim the space deleted snapshots still occupy. Safe for branch-based Pages (what the preview family uses). |
| `publish-workflow` | string  | `''`           | Workflow name pattern for the base-branch publish/deploy workflow that must succeed before a merged PR preview is removed (e.g. `'Quarto Publish*'` or `'Deploy Website'`). Matches against the workflow's declared display name (`name:`). If a workflow filename (`.yml` or `.yaml`) is provided, it is resolved via the GitHub API. Defaults to auto-detecting workflows with `'publish'` or `'deploy'` in their name. Set to `'none'` or `'false'` to disable. |
| `wait-for-publish` | boolean | `true`         | When `true` (default), wait until the base branch's publish/deploy workflow succeeds before removing preview directories for merged PRs. When `false`, merged PR previews are removed immediately regardless of publish status.     |

## Permissions

Grant `contents: write` (commit the deletions to `gh-pages`),
`pull-requests: read`, and `actions: read` (query workflow runs
to ensure merged PR previews are not pruned before deployment).

## Example

Do not name a `concurrency:` group `gh-pages` anywhere in your caller
workflow -- neither a top-level block nor one on the calling job, which
deadlock identically.
Any other group name is fine, and is how you serialize the caller's own
runs.
`cleanup-pr-previews.yml` serializes its gh-pages branch modifications
with the deploy workflows on its `cleanup` job (`group: gh-pages`).
A caller-level block with the same group name deadlocks GitHub Actions
against the nested job: `cleanup` fails with no runner, no steps, and no log.
This workflow publishes nothing, so the symptom is not a stale site: the
deletions never land, and preview directories for closed PRs accumulate on
gh-pages ([gha#809](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/issues/809)).

```yaml
# Copy to .github/workflows/cleanup-pr-previews.yml in your repo.
# Housekeeping half of the PR-preview family: periodically deletes gh-pages
# preview directories for PRs that are no longer open. The calling job grants
# contents:write so it can commit the deletions back to gh-pages.
name: Clean up PR Previews

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 0" # Weekly on Sunday at midnight UTC

jobs:
  cleanup:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: read
    uses: Morrison-Lab/gha/.github/workflows/cleanup-pr-previews.yml@v3
    # with:
    #   preview-dir: pr-preview     # gh-pages dir holding the per-PR previews
    #   compact-history: true       # orphan-squash gh-pages to one commit after
    #                               # pruning, so deleted snapshots stop bloating
    #                               # the repo. Branch-based Pages only.
    #   publish-workflow: ''        # base-branch publish workflow name/pattern
    #   wait-for-publish: true      # wait for publish before pruning merged PRs
```

See
[`examples/cleanup-pr-previews.yml`](https://github.com/Morrison-Lab/gha/blob/main/examples/cleanup-pr-previews.yml)
for the full caller stub.
